answer: Key demographic factors include gender, ethnicity, age, cultural background, and socioeconomic status, all of which play a crucial role in how individuals respond to these tools. Different genders may have varying attitudes towards suicide and mental health, which can affect their responses. Cultural backgrounds shape beliefs about mental health and suicide, influencing how individuals interpret questions in assessment tools. Younger and older populations may express suicidal ideation differently, necessitating age-appropriate tools and approaches.
